mentions.name: Neighborhood commercial re-legalization advocacy
mentions.description: This advocacy effort works to re-legalize "neighborhood commercial" by right in the author's city, pursuing approaches such as Accessory Commercial Units (ACUs) and home conversions to allow corner stores, small barber shops, coffee shops and converted restaurants in residential areas.
mentions.problem: Neighborhood commercial uses such as corner stores and small shops are not currently allowed by right in the author's city, requiring re-legalization through zoning changes.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to re-legalize "neighborhood commercial" by right in the city I live in. Things like corner stores or small barber shops or coffee shops or converted restaurants. ACUs or Accessory Commercial Units, home conversions... different ways of doing it.
